text: Welcome to Money Management and Budget.
Money comes in. That's your income, whatever it looks like for you this month.
Then money goes out, in a lot of directions.
Some of these you have to pay. Others you get to choose.
Needs keep you housed, fed, connected, and able to get to work.
Wants are the extras that make life better. Streaming, dining out, games, new shoes.
A budget gives every dollar a job. Needs first, then wants, then savings, even if it's a little.
Here's one to think about. What is one want you could trade for savings?
